assumptions: This is a hypothetical demo concept.
Market research does not establish real customer proportions.
Proposed standout performance has not been tested.
limitations: Three selected paid peers per category; not all competitors or a representative market census.
Use one-time USD prices for physical products and short-term monthly USD costs for software. Exclude annual equivalents, human packages, free tiers, and cart promotions from those price medians.
Use independently sorted numeric fields; categorical baselines are common features or explicit design choices. No median invented for missing/unknown fields.
Store marketed standout and two deliberate disadvantages separately; final offers are median-derived concepts with stated exceptions, not literal all-field median products.
Customer-facing simulation offers must not expose negative/standout labels or this research rationale. Show factual attributes uniformly for all alternatives.
Known free/DIY and human substitutes remain choice options even when excluded from paid-peer arithmetic.
Manufacturer lumen/capacity claims and software feature claims are not independent performance tests.
Sony and CodeSensei remain unchanged; this research covers only the four newly selected scenarios.
